job.title: Teacher of Latin & Classical Civilisation
job.description:
A leading independent school in London requires a teacher of Latin and Classical Civilisation from January, 2027. The post would entail teaching both Latin and Classical Civilisation to A level.
 
Essential:  Prior experience teaching Latin and Classical Civilisation at KS5, or applications from strong ECTs or postgraduates would also be warmly considered. Full support would be provided for the ECT Induction.
 
Desired: Experience teaching Latin and/or Classical Civilisation at A level and a background in the independent sector would be a bonus; however, this is not essential.    

The successful candidate will be able to convey their enthusiasm and commitment to students of all ages and to encourage self-motivation and  a genuine love of learning and enquiry. Steeped in tradition, the school places an equal emphasis on academic excellence and a robust pastoral care system. The school are looking to appoint an inspirational teacher who is able to engage pupils through creative yet stimulating lessons. Being able to offer inspirational teaching is central to the school's ethos. 


If you are passionate about the classical world and who would like the opportunity to teach in a top school, please forward your CV as soon as possible by clicking the 'Apply' button.

Harris Hill is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and expect all partners to share this commitment.

job.title: Business Studies Teacher
job.description:

Salary: £33000 - £55000

Benefits: TPS and the possibility of accommodation

Start date: January 2027; however, an earlier start would also be considered.

 

The role:

A leading independent school on the Surrey borders requires a teacher of Business from January 2027; however, an earlier start would also be considered. This is a permanent post which would entail teaching Business studies to A level. The possibility of accommodation is available.

 

The school:
The school encourages independence of thought and tailors the learning experience to individual needs, thereby securing higher levels of achievement.  They give the students progressive responsibilities and encourage their participation in worthwhile activities beyond the classroom so that they achieve genuine fulfilment as well as a well-rounded, holistic education in all areas. Encompassed within the school's mission is for pupils to seek to make a contribution to society and develop as upstanding role models.

 

Diversity and Inclusion:

One of the school's central tenets is a commitment to diversity and inclusion. A diverse staff shows pupils that anyone can succeed.

 

Essential:

Prior experience teaching Business or applications from strong ECTs or postgraduates would also be warmly received. Full support would be provided for the ECT Induction.

Desired:

A background in the independent sector, would be a bonus, however, this is certainly not essential.

 

How to apply:
If you would like the opportunity to teach in a top independent school, please forward your CV asap to: devra.farhi@harrishill.co.uk or please ask for Devra for an informal chat on: 020 7820 7308.
